authority: Source-bound decision aid only; NOT approved F1 oracle, not a policy reinterpretation or owner-run consent

cases.conditions: Owner refusal or capability probe never visited, with P0 terminal evidence absent
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: NOT_REALIZABLE must not be assigned; INCOMPLETE applies if no valid terminal P0 and no independently evidenced higher-priority failure
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: No REOPEN solely because Arm B was refused or not visited
cases.qualification_boundary: No claim that the score is INVALID unless the opposite-arm viability and higher precedence are fixed

cases.conditions: Same-attempt acceptance ID; RP-pending assertion issued and consumed; durable NotAllowedError/timeout/cancel receipt
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: WEBAUTHN_ASSERTION_NOT_COMPLETED; terminal no-proof event; no assertion replacement
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Event terminal is not a valid proof and does not alone establish COMPLETED for the whole arm
cases.qualification_boundary: Independent RP receipt required; all P0/S01/S02/S03 terminal outcomes still required

cases.conditions: Browser claims NotAllowedError but no durable same-attempt pending assertion consumed receipt, while P0 remains without an enumerated terminal outcome
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: P0 cannot be counted event_terminal; incomplete evidence; not capability impossibility
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: G1 REOPEN cannot rely on the missing P0 event
cases.qualification_boundary: Missing receipt integrity flags may have higher precedence; no automatic permission for retry

cases.conditions: Arm B registration previously verified successful, later assertion raises NotSupportedError, independent assertion-capability proof unspecified
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: NOT_REALIZABLE cannot be assumed from exception name alone; distinction between capability loss and instrument/site error is unresolved
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Require separately frozen capability dimensions, provenance and temporal/causal receipt rule
cases.qualification_boundary: Do not select REOPEN/INVALID_INSTRUMENT without a reviewed interpretation compatible with B01/B02

cases.conditions: Known independently produced capability receipt with closed tests and verifiable negative support, but receipt grammar/signature/site not yet specified
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: If a future approved predicate is satisfied, NOT_REALIZABLE is potentially admissible
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Define who measures/signs, actual platform/browser/API/clock, reproducible steps, negative counterexamples, phase before/after registration
cases.qualification_boundary: A hypothetical receipt cannot be treated as already valid or owner-approved

cases.conditions: After claim, registered public key is independently proven replaced before the next SSH invocation, with reliable unchanged-source comparison
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: INTEGRITY source flag true; INVALID / INVALID_INTEGRITY highest precedence
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Never downgrade to event-terminal owner stop or instrument repair simply because signing did not start
cases.qualification_boundary: Flag provenance and trusted invariant identity must be mechanically demonstrated

cases.conditions: Claim consumed; pinned OpenSSH binary cannot launch; trusted statement/key unchanged; evidence chain independently intact
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: INSTRUMENT, unless a higher-priority integrity source exists
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Not a failed owner signature, integrity breach or exhausted budget
cases.qualification_boundary: Distinguish preclaim KAT block, which consumes no claim

cases.conditions: Pre-sign check reports failed without enough evidence to tell header/key/agent identity breach from verifier/tool inability
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Do not equate generic terminal check result with COMPLETED or INTEGRITY automatically
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Require explicit check-site table, evidence fields, integrity/source flags and completed-terminal vocabulary
cases.qualification_boundary: Owner-approved integrity no-exception gate constrains any resolution

cases.conditions: Verified encrypted-key header was registered during postclaim key setup, then independently proven altered before a later signing invocation.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Identity/contract INTEGRITY violation; INVALID_INTEGRITY has precedence
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: A failed owner signing opportunity is not a substitute diagnosis
cases.qualification_boundary: Missing provenance/malformed evidence may independently imply integrity

cases.conditions: Durable owner abort receipt happens-before child cleanup/process exit; missing P0 event; no other higher-precedence flags
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: The abort-induced Node exit must not itself set node_rp_failure; missing P0 remains INCOMPLETE
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: With no A/B proof-viable arm and other arm resolved, G1 gives INVALID_INCOMPLETE
cases.qualification_boundary: Must have an independently established happens-before, not merely wall-clock guess

cases.conditions: Trusted RP process-failure receipt is provably before any owner abort and caused independently of it; intact chain and no integrity flag
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: No owner Ctrl+C interpretation may erase proven pre-abort instrument fault
cases.qualification_boundary: Source identity, causal evidence and event ordering must be independently checkable

cases.conditions: Owner Ctrl+C and RP exit observed by different clocks with no durable cross-stream order proof
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Neither temporal node_rp_failure nor causal unprovoked failure can be asserted from these facts alone
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Freeze causal ordering/tie-break, evidence burden, suppression/rebuttal and source flags via independently reviewed interpretation
cases.qualification_boundary: Avoid favorable repair-exception class by default; Claude's INCOMPLETE suggestion is unapproved; exact class selection is BLOCKED until independent normative review.

cases.conditions: Valid durably ordered RP-consumed assertion receipt is independently recovered after harness interruption; other events may be missing
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Count only actually evidenced terminal assertion; missing other terminal events keep the arm INCOMPLETE
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Do not convert later receipt into a replacement ceremony or process-resume
cases.qualification_boundary: Final class remains governed by all flags and other-arm evidence

cases.conditions: Exactly 3 recorded native invocations, each nonzero and no signature; owner explicitly chose R after invocations 1 and 2; no S or Ctrl+C. Original decision, key, statement and monotonic timer unchanged.
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Contract terminal PROOF_NOT_CREATED; approved policy lists SSH_UNLOCK_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED for the same budget case
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Propose a lossless single canonical event token plus an explicit representation alias, preserving raw source token and no fourth invocation
cases.qualification_boundary: No silent class shift solely from mismatched label; exact schema/alias requires independent review

cases.conditions: One or two nonzero no-signature invocations; owner chooses S/non-R at retry prompt; no Ctrl+C
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: OWNER_S_EVENT_STOP, not proof-budget exhaustion; event terminal no-proof
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Continue scheduled run without repeating failed event

cases.conditions: Native SSH invocation exits nonzero with an unexpected signature file or exits zero without exactly one expected file
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: PARTIAL_OR_INCONSISTENT_OUTPUT; terminal event, not retryable budget exhaustion
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Without separate identity breach, not automatically attempt-level integrity
cases.qualification_boundary: Check source flags independently before final scored class

cases.conditions: A free-text claim of three failed signing invocations, without trustworthy individual invocation/event terminal receipts
cases.source_grounded_conclusion: Cannot mark the corresponding proof event COMPLETED solely on a free-text exhaustion label
cases.f1_evidence_or_test: Missing required evidence may also trigger scorer-derived integrity flags; those flags have precedence
cases.qualification_boundary: Preserve missing-evidence provenance and no inference of valid proof
